scripts.install:all: cd server && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && ./venv/bin/uvicorn fockit_project.asgi:application --reload --port 3001" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build
